perks.name: Fanfare
perks.description: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
perks.exact:
While Ammo = ≤50% of Magazine AND Ammo ≠ 0:
+15 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

Does not trigger at 0 Ammo. rip bows, GLs, and Rockets

perks.name: Suros Harmony
perks.description: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
perks.exact:
Upon finishing a reload:
SUROS Harmony | +30? Handling and ?% Flinch Resist for 6 seconds.
Weapons that have the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait equipped, as well as SUROS Regime are additionally granted +15 Range. 
For some reason, the +Range benefit's timer begins only once you are able to shoot in the reload animation instead of when the ammo is refilled.

SUROS Harmony persists through stow, but only on the weapon that it was triggered on. 
Can be refreshed by retriggering the buff unless it is a SUROS Weapon lmao.

item.name: Radiant Light
item.description: Casting your Super causes nearby allies with at least one Armor Charge to gain an additional one. Allies that have a different Super element than you gain an additional Armor Charge.
item.exact:
On Super Cast:

 Grants x1 Armor Charge to Allies within 21 metres.
Caster receives x1 Armor Charge if already Charged.

Allies on different Subclasses are granted x2 Armor Charge.
